tools/prepare_px4.py: startup = replace_line(startup, DDS_ANCHOR, '# DDS client omitted: this simulator uses MAVLink.', "rcS")

dds_anchor = DDS_ANCHOR if DDS_ANCHOR in startup.splitlines() else "uxrce_dds_client start -t udp -p $uxrce_dds_port $uxrce_dds_ns"
    startup = replace_line(startup, dds_anchor, '# DDS client omitted: this simulator uses MAVLink.', "rcS")

scripts/run_px4.sh: printf '%s\n' 'Actuator channels: 0 aileron, 1 elevator, 2 rudder, 3 throttle. QGroundControl: UDP 14550.'
printf '%s\n' 'Actuator channels: 0 aileron, 1 elevator, 2 rudder, 3 throttle.'
printf '%s\n' 'Offboard connection is delegated to your MAVLink router.'
printf 'MAVLink router: UDP %s; QGC/app: use router endpoints.\n' "${XOVIUM_ROUTER_PX4_PORT:-14550}"

if [[ -d "$PX4_ROOT/.git" || -f "$PX4_ROOT/.git" ]]; then
    version="$(git -C "$PX4_ROOT" describe --tags --always 2>/dev/null || true)"
    if [[ ! "$version" =~ ^v1\.16(\.|$) ]]; then
        printf 'Expected PX4 v1.16 source; found %s in %s.\n' "$version" "$PX4_ROOT" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
fi

expected_commit='@XOVIUM_PX4_COMMIT@'
actual_commit="$(git -C "$PX4_ROOT" rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null || true)"
if [[ "$actual_commit" != "$expected_commit" ]]; then
    printf 'Expected managed PX4 @XOVIUM_PX4_VERSION@ (%s); found %s in %s.\n' "$expected_commit" "${actual_commit:-no Git checkout}" "$PX4_ROOT" >&2
    exit 1
fi
